description: Per-column codecs: structural bit-packed codecs for c_name/genome/hex/uuid/location; byte-pair-encoding token dictionary with context-conditioned length-limited canonical Huffman cells (fixed k-bit cells, positional and prev-token-bucket contexts) for text columns; nibble-delta row index for O(1) random row access. Same archive serves full decode and row selection.
name: dbtext-glm-structural-token
